'''Dented Droid''' were a commercial chain of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] repair shops which were in business during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Stores in the chain could be found in [[City/Legends|cities]], [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including one [[Dented Droid (The Wheel)|store]] on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. The Wheel store was run by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Jilaa San]], who often took on to much work at once and ended up working way past deadlines due to poor timekeeping and organization.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dented Droid first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. The Wheel store was included as somewhere that players could potentially interact with whilst searching for information on the Wheel.
